.PHONY: install test clean lint format help

# Default target
help:
	@echo "PropScan - Makefile targets:"
	@echo "  install    Install PropScan and dependencies"
	@echo "  test       Run unit tests"
	@echo "  lint       Run code linting"
	@echo "  format     Format code with black"
	@echo "  clean      Clean build artifacts"
	@echo "  dev        Install in development mode"
	@echo "  help       Show this help message"

# Install PropScan
install:
	pip3 install -e .

# Development installation
dev:
	pip3 install -e .[dev]

# Run tests
test:
	python3 -m pytest tests/ -v

# Run linting
lint:
	python3 -m flake8 src/propscan/ tests/
	python3 -m pylint src/propscan/

# Format code
format:
	python3 -m black src/propscan/ tests/
	python3 -m isort src/propscan/ tests/

# Clean build artifacts
clean:
	rm -rf build/
	rm -rf dist/
	rm -rf *.egg-info/
	find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} +
	find . -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete

# Build package
build:
	python3 setup.py sdist bdist_wheel

# Check package
check:
	python3 -m twine check dist/*
